about.title: About TerraGuard System
about.subtitle: Next-Generation AI & GIS Landslide Early Warning System for Critical Himalayan Corridors
about.multiSourceDesc: Seamlessly integrates Sentinel-1 InSAR synthetic aperture radar, NASA SRTM 30m digital elevation models, IMD gridded rainfall telemetry, and real-time piezometric soil pore sensors.
about.dualMlDesc: Trained on 19 historical landslide datasets. Features an ensemble Random Forest classifier (94.1% test precision) alongside a Bidirectional LSTM neural network forecasting 12-hour lead times.
about.capSirenDesc: Instantaneous Common Alerting Protocol (CAP) wireless emergency dispatch across cell broadcast, local LoRa relays, and physical acoustic sirens with quick silence overrides.
about.riskSimDesc: Run inference with real trained Random Forest on custom terrain, soil and cumulative rainfall.
about.pipelineSandboxDesc: Inspect metrics, feature importance, confusion matrices, and ROC curves on 19 datasets.
about.temporalIngestionDesc: Live sensor ingestion simulation and 24-hour lead-time projection graphs.
about.tacticalCapDesc: Trigger CAP emergency broadcasts and dispatch relief convoys to shelters.
about.crowdsourceCvDesc: Citizen photo submission with automated Computer Vision rockfall verification.
about.footerCompliant: TerraGuard v2.4 Enterprise • Geological Survey of India (GSI) & National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) Compliant
about.footerBuiltWith: Built with React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet GIS, FastAPI & Scikit-Learn
